description: DailyCheck external integration subset: 19 tools; runtime registry: 32 tools including 13 canonical tools. Subset membership is documentation, not authorization. Full maintenance ledger: registry.json.

tools.description: List all warehouses accessible to this token, returning code and display name. Returns: array of {code, name}.
tools.name: warehouse_list

tools.description: List all items in a warehouse. Returns: array of {id, sku, name, category_id, category_name, current_stock, safety_stock, unit, unit_cost, gram_per_unit, updated_at}.
tools.name: items_list

tools.description: Get full details for a single inventory item by ID. Returns: {id, sku, name, category_id, category_name, current_stock, safety_stock, unit, unit_cost, gram_per_unit, updated_at}.
tools.name: items_detail

tools.description: List recent stock movements (outbound requests and stocktake adjustments) for a warehouse. Returns: array of {id, type, item_id, item_name, qty, reason, created_at}.
tools.name: movements_list

tools.description: Create a restock (inbound) record. Returns: {id, item_id, quantity, warehouse_code, doc_no, line_no, input_quantity, factor, status, rolled_back, replayed, applied}. quantity is effective base units; replay does not apply stock again; deleted keys remain consumed.

doc_no.description: Opaque, case-sensitive identity; caller convention <source>:<external_doc_no> (e.g. juleng:JL-001); UTF-8 <=512 bytes, no controls or edge whitespace. Supply together with line_no; explicit null invalid.

factor.description: Finite positive source-to-base multiplier, applied once before 2dp HALF_EVEN rounding; may be used without a document key.

line_no.description: Opaque line identity; preserves leading zeros; UTF-8 <=256 bytes, no controls or edge whitespace. Supply together with doc_no; explicit null invalid.

tools.name: restock_create

tools.description: List inbound restock requests for a warehouse with pagination. Returns: {items: [{id, item_id, item_name, quantity, status, reason, created_at, doc_no, line_no, input_quantity, factor}], total, limit, offset, truncated}.

offset.description: Page offset (default 0; negative values are treated as 0).

tools.name: restock_list

tools.description: Get consumption forecast for an item. Returns: {item_id, warehouse_code, horizon_days, daily_avg, forecast_total, confidence, computed_at, data_status}.
tools.name: item_forecast

tools.description: Get procurement recommendations for a store. Returns: {warehouse_code, computed_at, items: [{item_id, item_name, current_qty, in_transit_qty, daily_avg, forecast_total_horizon, safety_stock, suggested_qty}]}.
tools.name: procurement_store

tools.description: Get procurement recommendations aggregated across all warehouses. Returns: {computed_at, items: [{item_id, item_name, total_suggested_qty, stores_needing, stores_detail}]}.
tools.name: procurement_hub

tools.description: Create an outbound record. Returns: {id, item_id, quantity, warehouse_code, doc_no, line_no, input_quantity, factor, status, rolled_back, replayed, applied}. quantity is effective base units; replay does not apply stock again; deleted keys remain consumed.

doc_no.description: Opaque, case-sensitive identity; caller convention <source>:<external_doc_no> (e.g. juleng:JL-001); UTF-8 <=512 bytes, no controls or edge whitespace. Supply together with line_no; explicit null invalid.

factor.description: Finite positive source-to-base multiplier, applied once before 2dp HALF_EVEN rounding; may be used without a document key.

line_no.description: Opaque line identity; preserves leading zeros; UTF-8 <=256 bytes, no controls or edge whitespace. Supply together with doc_no; explicit null invalid.

quantity.description: Quantity to outbound (must be <= current stock)

tools.name: outbound_create

tools.description: List outbound requests for a warehouse with pagination. Returns: {items: [{id, item_id, item_name, quantity, reason, status, rolled_back, created_at}], total, limit, offset, truncated}.

offset.description: Page offset (default 0; negative values are treated as 0).

tools.name: outbound_list

tools.description: Roll back an outbound request: return stock to warehouse. Returns: {id, item_id, quantity}.

request_id.description: Outbound request ID to roll back

tools.name: outbound_rollback

tools.description: Return per-item consumption summary for a warehouse with rank, qty, daily avg, turnover rate, and percentage. Returns: {items: [{rank, item_id, sku, name, category_name, unit, current_stock, safety_stock, consume_qty, active_days, daily_avg, turnover_rate, consume_pct, first_date, last_date}], warehouse_turnover: {window_days, warehouse_cogs_value, warehouse_avg_inventory_value, turnover_value, items_with_turnover, items_total, data_quality, method}}.

sort_by.description: Sort by: qty (default), value, turnover, name

tools.name: warehouse_consumption

tools.description: Return consumption stats for a single item: 7d / 14d / 30d / monthly totals, weekly breakdown. Opt-in include_turnover adds a stocktake-anchored inventory turnover estimate. Returns: {item_id, sku, name, category_name, unit, current_stock, safety_stock, consume_7d{qty,window_days,daily_avg}, consume_14d{...}, consume_30d{...}, consume_monthly{...}, weekly[{...}], [opt-in when include_turnover=true: inventory_turnover]}.

include_turnover.description: If true, also return inventory_turnover (stocktake-anchored average-inventory estimate). Default false.

tools.name: item_consumption

tools.description: List store orders (store ordering / DC transfer documents) visible to this token. Read-only. Visibility is by participating warehouse: an order is visible when the token is allowed on its store warehouse or on ANY participating warehouse (a line's source warehouse, with the header DC as legacy fallback). ACL expansion (explicit): a token allowed on any participating warehouse can read the full order, including line items fulfilled by other warehouses and their amounts. Optional filters: warehouse_code (matches the store side or any participating warehouse of an order), status, limit, offset. Returns: {orders: [{id, order_no, store_warehouse_code, dc_warehouse_code, flow_type, status, requested_by, expected_delivery_date, created_at, updated_at, ...}], total, limit, offset, truncated}.

warehouse_code.description: Optional warehouse code filter; matches an order whose store warehouse or any participating warehouse is this warehouse (e.g. wh_000).

tools.name: store_order_list

tools.description: Get one store order with its header, line items, deliveries, receipts and status history. Read-only. Visible when the token is allowed on the store warehouse or on ANY participating warehouse; ACL expansion (explicit): such a token can read the full order, including line items fulfilled by other warehouses, their amounts and the receipt history. Returns: {order: {id, order_no, store_warehouse_code, dc_warehouse_code, flow_type, status, ...}, items: [{id, canonical_id, canonical_name, dc_item_id, dc_item_bound, source_warehouse_code, quantity, fulfilled_quantity, shipped_quantity, unit, status}], deliveries: [{..., warehouse_code}], receipts: [...], status_history: [...]}.
tools.name: store_order_detail

tools.description: Read-only: current stock of this tenant in the external WMS (Puyu cold store, SQL Server). Returns: array of {goods_code, goods_name, unit, qty, warehouse, zone, position, lot_no}.

goods_code.description: Optional goods code filter, e.g. SC0001

tools.name: wms_stock_list

tools.description: Read-only: stock totals per warehouse for this tenant in the external WMS. Returns: array of {warehouse, sku_count, total_qty}.
tools.name: wms_stock_summary

tools.description: Read-only: inbound/outbound documents of this tenant in the external WMS. Returns: array of {doc_no, biz_date, warehouse, qty, supplier|receiver, issued_by}.
tools.name: wms_documents_list
